metadata.title: Spherically Supported Sets with Variable Radii
metadata.abstract: We study closed sets for which, at every boundary point, there exists a containing supporting ball whose prescribed radius may vary from point to point. This extends the notion of spherical support from constant to variable radii. The variable-radius setting presents a new difficulty: unlike the constant-radius case, the intersection of the supporting balls need not be strongly convex with respect to the prescribed radii. We overcome this difficulty by associating with every such set a canonical set and an induced radius function determined by the active supporting balls. For continuous prescribed radii, our main result establishes a geometric dichotomy: the original set either coincides with the canonical set and is strongly convex with respect to the prescribed radii, or it is contained in the boundary of the canonical set, which is strongly convex with respect to the induced radii. An example shows that the induced radii cannot, in general, be replaced by the prescribed ones in the second alternative. We also recover the constant-radius theory and characterize variable-radius strong convexity in terms of the spherical support of the boundary.

analysis.progressType: 变半径球支撑的几何二分
analysis.workSummary: 对边界各点具有不同半径包含支撑球的闭集，构造规范集及由活跃球诱导的半径，证明连续预设半径下的强凸性二分。
analysis.breakthrough: 说明第二种情形必须使用诱导半径，不能照搬常半径交球理论。
analysis.limitations: 需要连续半径假设；原集可能只落在规范集边界，而非自身强凸。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
